name: Christmas in the Village at the Strongsville Historical Village
when_note: Saturday and Sunday, December 5 and 6, 1 to 4 PM each day
paras: The Strongsville Historical Society hosts its annual Christmas in the Village at 13305 Pearl Road on Saturday and Sunday, December 5 and 6, from 1 to 4 PM each day. The City of Strongsville lists the event and states that admission is free.
Visitors can step back in time for an old-fashioned Christmas, meet Santa, see a model train display and take in the holiday decorations.
Children can also make gingerbread houses with the Girl Scouts. The Historical Society's own website has more about the village.
tip: Both days run the same 1 to 4 PM hours, so pick the day that suits your family.
